findings.description: SYS-SUP-033 requires the latch, per-code counts and fault history to survive software and watchdog resets. SYE-SUP-067 uses the microcontroller as a placeholder; no reset-retentive storage element or its reset and power-loss behavior is established.
findings.requested_change: Identify and allocate storage with the required reset and power-loss behavior, and complete the retained-state interface.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-015 requires fault-free start-up without a watchdog reset. Watchdog activation, first-refresh timing and integrity-check duration remain unresolved, so the start-up sequence cannot establish that outcome.
findings.requested_change: Define an evidenced start-up watchdog activation and servicing sequence that accommodates the integrity checks.

findings.description: DEC-SYE-006 reserves 5% of processor time for the run-time check and 5% for the remaining supervisor work. OP-SYE-007 records that CRC throughput and other execution costs are unknown, so feasibility of SYS-SUP-022, SYS-SUP-052 and SYS-SUP-058 remains unshown.
findings.requested_change: Provide evidence and a resource budget showing that the run-time check and the complete supervisor meet their limits.

findings.description: DEC-SYE-008 requires protection against application writes to watchdogs, outputs, the time base and supervisor data, but OP-SYE-008 leaves the enforcing mechanism unresolved. Consequently SYS-SUP-010 and the safety reaction cannot be established against those interference cases.
findings.requested_change: Resolve the protection decision and allocate an evidenced enforcement mechanism or the approved system-level treatment of the residual risk.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-053 and SYS-SUP-054 require fault injection and verification without the real board. OP-SYE-004 records that the named environments' GPIO, serial and reset-flag observation and stimulation capabilities are not established.
findings.requested_change: Establish the required simulator or host observation and stimulation capabilities and their integration interfaces.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-047 requires the total report count to survive software and watchdog resets, and SYS-SUP-032 and SYS-SUP-059 limit loss of accumulated fault-free time across resets. SYE-SUP-067 lists only the latch, per-code detection counts and eight-entry history; it does not carry the report count or accumulated operating time.
findings.requested_change: Specify the retained report count and accumulated fault-free operating time in the retained-state allocation and interface, including updates sufficient to meet the stated loss limits.
